'''Daiman's ship''' was one of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s vessels.<ref name="Knight" />

==Description==
It was somewhat similar in appearance to the then-ancient [[Sith fighter]]s of Darth [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|empire]].<ref name="Knight" />

*[[Knight Errant 0|''Knight Errant'' 0]]
